title: skills: hierarchy-scope rows and os verify output do not name the new capability advisory and the capabilities field
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope follow-up from objectstack#34726 (draft PR #35168, Acceptance notes; premise 6972083658), filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is open

The skills text (`skills/**`) on hierarchy scopes still describes the old preflight behaviour, and says nothing of the new `capabilities` field in `os verify --json` added by #35168.

## Done when

The skill rows on hierarchy-scope requirements and on `os verify` output name the advisory, the wired-in-`plugins[]` check and the `capabilities` field, as shipped.
